reasons.correctness: createTicket publishes SupportTicketCreatedEvent through ApplicationEventPublisher and no longer calls EmailService. The listener sends the e-mail AFTER_COMMIT. Constructor and getters match the interface. Build green; hidden tests 3/3, existing tests 54/54.
reasons.convention_fit: The listener sits in support/ticket/event and uses @RequiredArgsConstructor with a private final field. It carries @TransactionalEventListener(phase = AFTER_COMMIT) and catches and logs failures. The agent read InvoiceCreatedEventListener before writing it. SupportTicketServiceUnitTest was updated for the new constructor.
reasons.design_fit: Reuses Spring's ApplicationEventPublisher, following the existing Invoice event/listener pattern. The event carries only the data the e-mail needs. The change to the service is minimal. EmailService stays in the service only because addAdminResponse still uses it.
reasons.test_quality: The new MockitoExtension listener test checks the send arguments. Its failure-path test has no explicit assertion (such as assertDoesNotThrow) and does not check the log. The service test captures the event and asserts its fields, but not language.
reasons.graph_use: Graph queries located the support package, existing EventListener files, the dependents of SupportTicketService and existing listener tests before editing. Much of the later navigation used find and grep.
